recipient: sole owner-reporting director overseeing two distinct companies
intake: When the owner issues a new instruction in ChatGPT, ChatGPT uses an authorized GitHub write action to update this file and logs the user-authorized message in GitHub issue #9. Neither D nor the GitHub workflow can silently read future ChatGPT messages.

orders.instruction: Operate two entirely separate companies with the same 10-director structure: Company A transferexperiment/D01–D10 and Company B BountyScoutAI/D01–D10. Maintain independent workers and receiving-account evidence for each. A single Chief D above both separate company boards reports the consolidated results to the owner, and Chief D receives new owner instructions THROUGH ChatGPT only when the owner tells ChatGPT. Local D10 in each company handles only that company's payment evidence; local D01–D09 continue earning work. D must show verified completed jobs, genuine collectible debts, independent payer contact and actual blockchain receipts, and clearly distinguish missing external authentication.

Chief D, both fully separate companies must carry the SAME billion-scale hierarchical worker role structure. Provide a precise per-level count for each company and combined counts, keeping their distinct fleet-prefixed identities. Company 1 transferexperiment has 10 directors, 20 assistants, 150 managers, 7,500 W-level workers, 1,125,000 defined S roles, 562,500,000 defined G roles and 374,625,000,000 defined H roles; Company 2 BountyScoutAI has the identical count, as a separate namespace. Exactly one global Chief D is above the two company director boards and reports to owner through the ChatGPT-relayed instruction system. Confirm 375,188,632,680 defined role positions per company; 750,377,265,360 across both; and 750,377,265,361 including Chief D. Do not report definitions as live concurrently executing AI models. Show actual model process counts only from audited run evidence; continue same scheduled research/model pace and genuine payment work without inventing a receipt.

CHIEF D: Your standing mission across both independent companies is to obtain real, legitimately earned coins deposited into the two owner-controlled wallets on the correct network. The command must flow from Chief D through each fleet's distinct D01-D10 board and direct parent chain to every ACTUALLY EXECUTED B worker, across W/S/G/H levels. Strict accountability: every launched worker must submit a unique identity, real OS process and model evidence, original source checked, specific useful output, honest verified payer/amount status, exact next lawful action, limitation/blocker and supervisor. Directors must audit each launched worker's report, flag missing, empty, duplicate or unsupported work as failure, assign bounded reruns and provide one cross-company Chief D scorecard. Do NOT represent 750 billion lazily configured role IDs as 750 billion concurrently active agents; scale real executed processes to available authorized resources while clearly reporting capacity constraints. Internal model outputs or wallet monitor checks are NOT customer earnings. No invented deposits, fake client agreements, mass spam, harassment, private keys or upfront wallet fees. Make best effort to win genuine work, complete it, and collect verifiable payments; pursue more earning sources if none payable. Chief D is accountable directly to owner via the ChatGPT-relayed instruction channel.

CHIEF D: Everyone audit everyone across both separately governed companies, meaning every ACTUALLY EXECUTED worker's evidence is examined, every actual participant has a concrete peer-review assignment, each immediate supervisor checks subordinates, each company D01-D10 director reviews its team and cross-checks another director, both local D10s audit customer settlement evidence, and sole Chief D evaluates both companies and reports to owner. Use distributed and rotating peer audits and an independent supervisor/Chief D audit so all real worker outputs receive coverage without pretending 750B dormant role IDs performed O(N^2) reviews. Require distinct reviewer/reviewee IDs, public-source validation, reproducible report links, score, defects, corrective actions, and escalation. All audits must mark whether a real AI review actually executed vs a deterministic code check or simply a queued assignment. Failed or missing workers receive a follow-up slot. Core goal remains verifiably paid cryptocurrency received on the right network, with no invented earnings or false social outreach.

Chief D: public research information and non-sensitive discoveries are FREE AND OPEN for collaboration. Share verified public-source URLs, source excerpts within copyright constraints, safe research findings, reproducible work evidence, quality warnings, improvement recommendations, and non-sensitive peer-audit results across BOTH companies without silos. Every actually running worker and director can check other workers' evidence, within authorized tooling, using transparent cross-company sharing. Mark original sources as untrusted until verified and preserve independent judgment. Do NOT put private keys, seed phrases, passwords, unpublished client records, personal identity/contact details, or confidential commercial terms in public GitHub issues, artifact logs or shared research. Each autonomous model must still produce individual real findings, not an empty copied report. Peer reviews are evaluated honestly as deterministic checks or actual completed model-generated criticism; no fictional billions of cross-reviews or guaranteed incoming payments.

Chief D: The owner sets a specific target of SEVEN BILLION unique B worker identities to do real lawful cryptocurrency-earning work and understand owner orders across TWO completely separate companies. Partition the target evenly: 3,500,000,000 distinct eligible H-level role identities in each company's namespace, 350,000,000 per local D01-D10 director. Use deterministic indexed, reproducible, nonduplicating role selection to rotate ACTUAL model-process attempts through these pools within authorized free runner limits; every launched worker must respond individually to the current order, identify its exact direct supervisor, original evidence and concrete next earning action. Fail or flag missing/weak acknowledgements, and report attempted/completed/qualified model runs, payment acceptance, actual on-chain coins and still-unexecuted target explicitly. Do not claim all 7B worked or understood when they have not. Do not multiply GitHub runs recklessly, invent wallet receipts, misstate inactive definitions as live minds, or spam potential payers. Chief D delivers account-separated accountability report directly to owner through documented scheduled workflow.

Chief Director D: Correct and improve the reliability and commercial usefulness of the two separate B-worker companies, not only their paper hierarchy. Fix redundant full model runs triggered on each GitHub code edit, retain matched scheduled/manual capacity, verify the correct owner-to-Chief-D-to-local-director-to-parent chain, catch schema and syntax defects before expensive runs, and audit every actually invoked B worker's real model result. Prioritize genuine verified paying customers and delivered useful work over speculative wallet posts. Ensure local D10 on each company audits its own receivables, D01-D09 pursue useful work, and only one Chief D issues an owner-facing exception report. Recheck failures from GitHub job logs, record actual fix/test evidence, do not treat workflow job success as income, and never pretend 7B configured definitions are executing simultaneously. Use strict source validation, acknowledgements, missing/duplicate result rejection, no private keys/upfront fees/spam. Report every concrete improvement and remaining blockers truthfully.

strict_per_worker_reporting.rejection_policy: Mark empty, duplicate, ungrounded or unverifiable outputs NOT QUALIFIED; keep attempted and completed counts separate. Retry only within authorized real compute and reasonable rate limits, not claim every defined role is already running.
strict_per_worker_reporting.critical_business_goal: Actual legitimate cryptocurrency received into the account's correctly verified network wallet, not just worker activity.

peer_audit_rule.coverage: 100% of workers actually invoked, each reviewed by a different actual worker's evidence and supervisor where possible; avoid dishonest all-to-all claims
peer_audit_rule.rotation: Each executed worker gets an independent peer-review assignment, every executed worker appears as a reviewee, plus parent/team director and Chief D oversight
peer_audit_rule.failure_action: Record failed evidence grade, exact defect, responsible supervisor and next available legitimate rerun
peer_audit_rule.do_not_claim: Defined but never executed billions of roles cannot have real review activity; no payments from reviews alone

public_information_sharing_policy.scope: Both companies; public-source evidence and non-sensitive model findings may circulate among teams freely
publishable: public job URLs and original-source verification
reported performance grades, failed evidence checks, lessons learned
verified public blockchain transaction IDs with no inferred payer identity
not_publishable: wallet private keys or seed phrases
passwords, API tokens and session credentials
private individual identity or communication details
unverified assertions of payments or externally executed work
public_information_sharing_policy.audit_rule: Every peer review must distinguish automated validation from actual independent AI inference; sharing a report is not a separate agent's completed evaluation.

seven_billion_execution_target.execution_proof_rule: Only unique completed model invocations with report plus explicit current order response count; role index/configuration is not execution
seven_billion_execution_target.understanding_rule: Every actual worker's own response must state mission, next action, risk and correct order ID with supervisor check; otherwise NOT ACKNOWLEDGED
seven_billion_execution_target.payment_goal: Independently verified real on-chain credits from legitimate transactions, not research
